newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Petrobras mulls venture with PDVSA.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Petrobras mulls venture with PDVSA.

text.p: Brazilian state-run oil firm Petrobras is considering a joint drilling and production venture with Venezuela's Petroleos de Venezuela SA (PDVSA), the Petrobras president said on Wednesday.
Petrobras head Joel Renno told reporters in Brasilia he would be travelling to Caracas on Februray 17 to meet PDVSA officials and government representatives.
He said one of several possible joint ventures involved exploration in Venezuelan oilfields.
Petrobras' current crude production amounts to some 900,000 barrels per day (bpd) and should reach one million bpd by end-1997.

Venezuela, a charter member of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) has a crude production quota of 2.36 million barrels per day. The International Energy Agency (IEA) and independent monitors of OPEC quotas put Venezuela's December 1996 crude production at 3.05 million barrels per day.
